claude.manifest: Routes each subagent to a Claude model and effort that fits its task, judged by Jev. For each routed Agent call it sends the task text, condensed to at most 12,000 characters, the agent's description, cut to 500 characters, and the call's one-line description, all with token-shaped strings such as keys masked, to api.typesafe.ai, openrouter.ai or both, as its provider option allows, each with its own key. The built-in general-purpose and claude agents send a fixed text in place of their description. The scope option picks the calls: core routes the four built-in agents, extended also routes user, project and plugin agents and sends their text. A config tool opens the plugin's own dialog to change both options. A key set as an environment variable is visible to every process Claude Code starts.
claude.catalogue: Routes each Claude Code subagent to a Claude model and effort that fits its task, judged by Jev. On every Agent call it sends the subagent's task text, condensed to at most 12,000 characters, the agent's description and the call's one-line description, all with token-shaped strings such as keys masked, to api.typesafe.ai, openrouter.ai or both, as its provider option allows, each with its own key. The built-in general-purpose and claude agents send a fixed text in place of their description.

omp.manifest: Routes Oh My Pi subagents to the smol, middle or slow model role and a thinking level that fits the task, judged by Jev. It scores a task even when you set no model, and sets the effort unless you set one. It sends the task text, condensed to at most 12,000 characters, and the agent's description, cut to 500 characters, with token-shaped strings such as keys masked, to api.typesafe.ai, openrouter.ai or both, as its provider setting allows. The bundled task agent sends a fixed text in place of its description. The scope setting picks the agents: core routes the bundled task agent, extended routes every agent whose model you did not set. A project can set scope, and extended there can raise spend on the middle and slow roles. The plugin can store a key you type in its dialog. A key set as an environment variable is visible to every process omp starts.
omp.catalogue: Routes each Oh My Pi task subagent to the smol, middle or slow model role and a thinking level that fits its task, judged by Jev from the redacted task text and the agent's description, which it sends to api.typesafe.ai, openrouter.ai or both, as its provider setting allows. The bundled task agent sends a fixed text in place of its description.

openclaw.manifest: Routes OpenClaw subagent spawns to your small, middle or large model and an effort that fits the task, judged by Jev. It scores a task even when you set no model, and sets the effort unless you set one. For each routed sessions_spawn call it sends the task text, condensed to at most 12,000 characters, the agent's description, cut to 500 characters, and the spawn's one-line label, all with token-shaped strings such as keys masked, to api.typesafe.ai, openrouter.ai or both, as its provider setting allows, each with its own key. The spawn of the requesting agent itself sends that agent's description when it has one and a fixed text when it has none. The plugin sets a model only from your small_model, middle_model and large_model settings, and only after OpenClaw resolves it and holds a credential for it. The scope setting picks the spawns: core routes the spawn of the requesting agent itself; extended also routes the spawns of other agents that set no model. A key set as an environment variable is visible to every process OpenClaw starts.

hermes.manifest: Routes Hermes Agent delegated tasks to your small, middle or large model and an effort that fits the task, judged by Jev. It scores a task even when you set no model, and sets the effort unless you set one. For each routed task it sends the task text, condensed to at most 12,000 characters, and the task's context, shortened to fit, both with token-shaped strings such as keys masked, to api.typesafe.ai, openrouter.ai or both, as its provider setting allows, each with its own key. It sends a fixed text in place of an agent description, and the task's description parameter, masked the same way and cut to 500 characters, when the delegating model sets one. The plugin sets a model only from your small_model, middle_model and large_model settings, and only after Hermes resolves its provider offline and lists the model. A key set as an environment variable is visible to every process Hermes starts.

descriptions.claude: Which providers may score a subagent call, and in which order. typesafe: TypeSafe only. openrouter: OpenRouter only. auto: TypeSafe, then OpenRouter if TypeSafe fails. openrouter-first: OpenRouter, then TypeSafe. With auto or openrouter-first and both keys set, one call may reach both companies.
descriptions.omp: Which providers judge each task, in order. auto: TypeSafe, then OpenRouter. openrouter-first: OpenRouter, then TypeSafe.
descriptions.openclaw: Which providers judge each task, in order. auto: TypeSafe, then OpenRouter. openrouter-first: OpenRouter, then TypeSafe.
descriptions.hermes: Which providers judge each task, in order. auto: TypeSafe, then OpenRouter. openrouter-first: OpenRouter, then TypeSafe.

descriptions.claude: Which Agent calls the plugin routes. core: the built-in agents general-purpose, claude, Explore and Plan only. extended: also any Agent call that passes no model, including plugin and user agents, replacing the model and effort their definition sets. Forks and named calls stay unrouted.
descriptions.omp: Which subagents are routed. core: the task agent only. extended: every agent whose model you did not set, bundled agents included.
descriptions.openclaw: Which spawns are routed. core: the spawn of the requesting agent itself. extended: also the spawns of other agents that set no model.

commandContents.provider: Call the tool mcp__model-router__config. With no setting it shows the router's settings. With the setting "provider" it asks the person which providers should score subagent calls and applies the answer. Pass no value, because the person chooses in the dialog. Show the tool's reply to the person. If the tool is missing, tell the person to open /config, find the model-router plugin, and set its provider option in the plugin's settings.
commandContents.scope: Call the tool mcp__model-router__config. With no setting it shows the router's settings. With the setting "scope" it asks the person which agent calls the router should route and applies the answer. Pass no value, because the person chooses in the dialog. Show the tool's reply to the person. If the tool is missing, tell the person to open /config, find the model-router plugin, and set its scope option in the plugin's settings.

api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
api_key.description: Your TypeSafe API key. The plugin sends it to TypeSafe only, as the bearer token of the scoring request, and only when the provider option allows TypeSafe. The README says where to get one.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: Your OpenRouter API key. The plugin sends it to OpenRouter only, as the bearer token of the scoring request, and only when the provider option allows OpenRouter.

small_model.label: Small model
small_model.help: The model a spawn gets when Jev rates its task small, written as provider/model. Unset: such a spawn keeps the model OpenClaw would give it, and the plugin still sets its effort unless you set one.
